newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end at new high, AEX pushes past 810.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end at new high, AEX pushes past 810.

text.p: 1445 GMT - Dutch shares reach new closing high, pushing through 810 for first time. Market shrugs off negative impact of French elections on bunds and dollar. Index heavyweights Royal Dutch and financials provide main impetus behind upward movement. Dutch chartists all upbeat on prospects for index with next resistance at or above 820.
* AEX index ends up 8.23 points, or 1.02 percent, at 812.19. In afternoon, index hits new intra-day high of 812.87.
* Royal Dutch ends up 5.50 guilders at 373.50.
* Financials gain on sentiment that interest rates will not gain and ahead ING, Fortis Amev Q1 results.
